name: life-compass
description: Static build for the Life Compass site. No bundler: Node runs the TypeScript build directly (type stripping), and the published site is plain HTML and CSS. See docs/decisions/0003.

scripts.//schema: The question definitions and their asks, written into src/client so the client can import them. Generated rather than committed; checkSpecifiers in build/client.ts is what guarantees it exists, not these hooks.
scripts.//typecheck: Two projects, both real TypeScript. The build runs from source; the client is emitted by build/client.ts and checked only here. See tsconfig.client.json.
scripts.//test: `ls` first so a zero-match glob fails the script. `node --test` exits 0 when its glob matches nothing, so a renamed or moved suite would report success having run no tests at all. Both globs are listed so a missing suite on either tier fails rather than shrinking the run silently.
